systems.headline: Clarity first. Architecture second. Production always.

step1.title: Shape the brief
step1.desc: Translate unclear goals into user flows, constraints, risks, and a version that can ship value.

step2.title: Design the system
step2.desc: Define contracts, data models, authentication, and service boundaries before implementation gets expensive.

step3.title: Build vertical slices
step3.desc: Move from interface to API to data in thin, testable increments with clean component boundaries.

step4.title: Harden the release
step4.desc: Add validation, edge case handling, documentation, and quality checks before production.

step5.title: Ship and support
step5.desc: Deploy, monitor, and leave the product with a clean path for maintenance and iteration.

knowledge.headline: The tools are broad. The decisions stay focused.

about.heroSubtext: I build polished web products from UX to API to deployment. The work is technical, but the standard is simple: make it feel clear, fast, and finished.
about.philosophyQuote: Ship the smallest valuable version. Refactor honestly. Leave the system calmer than you found it.
